LiveShield publishes sanitized video only and never microphone audio. It cannot intercept or replace the camera inside the normal TikTok app.
Use this only if TikTok has explicitly issued an RTMP server and stream key for this account. Not every account is eligible. LiveShield cannot obtain or bypass access.
